_comment: DRAFT for owner review (Provenance P2). Built-in allowlist of the Hebrew subtitle provenance badges; the user adds more handles in the setting custom_trusted_uploaders.

Entries are a name or {name, aliases, status, evidence}. Names are matched WHOLE and case-insensitively, ignoring spaces, dots, underscores and hyphens (yoav_1610 = Yoav1610). A name shorter than 3 letters / digits is never loaded.
status "proposed" = a suggestion that is NOT loaded until you delete that field. evidence is a note for the reviewer and is ignored at runtime.

studios -> VERIFIED_STUDIO; teams -> VERIFIED_TEAM (translator role, or a team account as uploader); translators -> VERIFIED_TRANSLATOR (translator role only); uploaders -> TRUSTED_UPLOADER (uploader field only); syncers -> shown in the panel as known sync / fetch names, never a badge; never -> never counted as anything.
